executiveSummary:
• All tests executed successfully with no failures recorded.
• The Login and Logout workflow showed a total execution time of 3902 ms.
• The NML510 Trial Balance Report workflow had the highest execution time at 18003 ms.
• The POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml endpoint was called 48 times in one test, indicating potential inefficiencies.
• High frequency of refresh calls may suggest optimization opportunities in the budget management processes.
• User actions are closely linked to specific API calls, highlighting the importance of UI-API documentation.
• Overall performance appears stable with no latency outliers detected.
